column1: # Extra examples for the coding book: word \t "english :: 中文" \t "english :: 中文"
# Short-ish sentence first, then a longer one that shows the word in flowing context.

column2: We implemented the fix in one afternoon. :: 我们用一个下午实现了这个修复。
column3: The team implemented the new billing flow behind a feature flag, so nobody noticed the change until the numbers started moving. :: 团队在功能开关后面实现了新的计费流程，所以在数字开始变化之前没人注意到这次改动。

column2: They deploy on Fridays now. :: 他们现在周五部署。
column3: We deploy behind a flag, watch the error rate for ten minutes, and only then let the change reach every user. :: 我们在开关后面部署，观察十分钟错误率，然后才让改动触达所有用户。

column2: Refactor after the tests pass. :: 测试通过之后再重构。
column3: We spent two days refactoring a function nobody had dared to touch, and the diff ended up smaller than the bug report. :: 我们花了两天重构一个没人敢碰的函数，最后的 diff 比那个 bug 报告还小。

column2: Commit one change at a time. :: 一次只提交一个改动。
column3: If you commit the refactor and the behaviour change together, the reviewer cannot tell which line caused the regression. :: 如果你把重构和行为改动放在同一个提交里，评审者就分不清是哪一行导致了回归。

column2: Merge once the checks are green. :: 检查变绿之后再合并。
column3: She merged the branch on Friday afternoon and spent the weekend wondering whether the cache invalidation was really correct. :: 她周五下午合并了分支，然后整个周末都在想缓存失效是不是真的没问题。

column2: Rebase onto main first. :: 先变基到 main。
column3: Rebasing a long-lived branch is painful, but it keeps the history readable when you finally open the pull request. :: 变基一个长期分支很痛苦，但等你终于开 PR 时,历史会好读得多。

column2: Make a branch for the spike. :: 为这次探索建个分支。
column3: We keep one branch per experiment, delete it the moment the answer is clear, and never let a dead branch live for a month. :: 每个实验一个分支，答案一清楚就删掉，绝不让死分支躺一个月。

column2: Clone the repo, then run make. :: 克隆仓库然后跑 make。
column3: He cloned the repository on a slow hotel network and gave up after twenty minutes of watching the progress bar crawl. :: 他在酒店慢网络下克隆仓库，看着进度条爬了二十分钟就放弃了。

column2: Fetch the tags before you cut a release. :: 打发布前先拉取标签。
column3: The build script fetches the latest tag, compares it with the version file, and fails loudly when the two disagree. :: 构建脚本拉取最新标签，和版本文件比对，两者不一致时大声报错。

column2: Push the branch and open a PR. :: 推送分支并开 PR。
column3: I pushed a fix at midnight, and by the morning three people had already reviewed it and found a better name for the helper. :: 我半夜推了一个修复，到早上已经有三个人评审过，还给那个辅助函数想了个更好的名字。

column2: Pull before you start editing. :: 开始改之前先拉取。
column3: Every morning she pulls the latest changes, reads the diff from yesterday, and only then decides what to work on. :: 每天早上她拉取最新改动，读一遍昨天的 diff，然后才决定做什么。

column2: Add the mirror as a second remote. :: 把镜像添加为第二个远端。
column3: The remote we had been pushing to for a year turned out to be a stale fork that nobody had updated since spring. :: 我们用了一年一直在推的那个远端，其实是个从春天起就没人更新过的旧 fork。

column2: The fix landed upstream on Tuesday. :: 这个修复周二进了上游。
column3: Once the patch is accepted upstream we can drop our local workaround, which has been confusing new contributors for months. :: 补丁被上游接受之后，我们就可以删掉本地那个绕行方案了，它已经让新贡献者困惑了好几个月。

column2: He forked the project to try an idea. :: 他 fork 了项目来试验一个想法。
column3: The fork drifted so far from upstream that merging the two back together would have cost more than rewriting the whole thing. :: 这个 fork 和上游偏离太远，把它们合回去的代价比整个重写还高。

column2: Apply the patch to the release branch. :: 把补丁打到发布分支上。
column3: We shipped a one-line patch on Thursday, and it fixed the crash that had been waking the on-call engineer every night for a week. :: 我们周四发了一个一行的补丁，解决了一个连续一周每晚都把值班工程师叫醒的崩溃。

column2: Keep the diff small and honest. :: 让 diff 小而诚实。
column3: The diff looked tiny, but it changed the meaning of a shared helper that forty other files happened to depend on. :: 这个 diff 看起来很小，但它改了一个四十个其他文件都恰好依赖的共享辅助函数的语义。

column2: The conflict is in one config file. :: 冲突只在一个配置文件里。
column3: Resolving the conflict took ten minutes, but understanding why both sides had edited the same line took the rest of the afternoon. :: 解决冲突花了十分钟，但搞清楚为什么两边改了同一行花了整个下午。

column2: Resolve it by hand, carefully. :: 小心地手动解决。
column3: She resolved the deadlock by giving every lock a global order, which felt obvious afterwards and took three days to find. :: 她给每把锁定了全局顺序来解决死锁，事后看显而易见，当时找了三天。

column2: Keep a rollback ready. :: 准备好回滚。
column3: The rollback took ninety seconds and saved the release, but the postmortem still asked why we had not caught the issue in staging. :: 回滚用了九十秒，救了这次发布，但复盘时大家仍在问：为什么预发环境没发现。

column2: Revert the commit if the metric drops. :: 指标下跌就还原提交。
column3: We reverted the change within an hour, which is exactly what the runbook says to do when latency doubles after a deploy. :: 我们在一小时内还原了改动，这正是操作手册规定的：部署后延迟翻倍时该做的事。

column2: Staging caught it before production did. :: 预发环境先于生产发现了问题。
column3: Staging mirrors production closely enough that we trust it, but not so closely that a mistake there costs real money. :: 预发环境和生产足够接近，我们信得过；又没接近到在那儿犯错要花真金白银。

column2: Set the token as an environment variable. :: 把令牌设成环境变量。
column3: The test passes locally and fails in CI because the two environments disagree about the time zone, not about the code. :: 测试本地通过、CI 失败，原因是两个环境对时区的看法不同，而不是代码。

column2: Keep configuration out of the code. :: 把配置从代码里拿出来。
column3: Half the incident came down to a configuration value that had been copied by hand into six services and updated in five of them. :: 这次事故有一半要归因于一个配置值：它被手工抄进六个服务，其中五个更新了。

column2: Every dependency is a promise. :: 每个依赖都是一份承诺。
column3: We added one small dependency for date parsing and inherited four transitive packages, two of which were already unmaintained. :: 我们为解析日期加了一个小依赖，结果继承了四个传递依赖，其中两个已经没人维护。

column2: The package has no sub-dependencies. :: 这个包没有子依赖。
column3: Publishing a package is easy; the hard part is deciding what to do when a thousand projects quietly depend on the bug you are about to fix. :: 发布一个包很容易，难的是当一千个项目悄悄依赖你即将修复的 bug 时你该怎么办。

column2: Install it in one command. :: 一条命令安装。
column3: The install takes ten seconds on a fast machine and four minutes on the laptop we actually use for development. :: 安装在一台快机器上要十秒，在我们真正用来开发的那台笔记本上要四分钟。

column2: Compile the assets once per deploy. :: 每次部署编译一次资源。
column3: The compiler is fast, but the type errors it reports on a Monday morning are not the ones you want to debug first. :: 编译器很快，但周一早上它报出的那些类型错误，绝不是你最想先调的东西。

column2: The build broke on a missing type. :: 构建因为缺一个类型失败。
column3: A green build is not proof that the code works; it is only proof that the parts we thought to test still fit together. :: 绿色构建不能证明代码能用，只能证明我们想到要测的那部分还拼得起来。

column2: Upload the artifact for later reuse. :: 上传产物以便复用。
column3: Every build uploads an artifact named after the commit, so months later you can still reproduce exactly what shipped on that Tuesday. :: 每次构建都上传一个以提交命名的产物，几个月后你仍能精确复现那个周二发布的东西。

column2: The bundle shrank by half. :: 打包体积减半了。
column3: We spent a week chasing bundle size and discovered that a single icon library was responsible for more weight than the entire application code. :: 我们花一周追查打包体积，最后发现一个图标库的重量超过整个应用代码。

column2: Minify only in production. :: 只在生产环境压缩。
column3: Minifying the output saved bandwidth, but it also made the stack traces unreadable until we uploaded source maps. :: 压缩输出省了带宽，但也让堆栈变得无法阅读，直到我们上传了 source map。

column2: The linter caught a real bug today. :: 静态检查今天抓到一个真 bug。
column3: Most lint rules are noise, and then one of them catches a mistake that would have taken a customer three days to report. :: 大多数 lint 规则都是噪音，然后其中一条抓到了一个客户可能三天后才报的错。

column2: Format on save. :: 保存时格式化。
column3: Formatting arguments are boring, which is exactly why automating them is worth more than the two minutes it saves each time. :: 格式化之争很无聊，正因如此，把它自动化比每次省两分钟更有价值。

column2: The default is five seconds. :: 默认五秒。
column3: The default should be safe for the common case, because most people will never read the setting and will simply live with whatever you chose. :: 默认值应该对常见情况是安全的，因为大多数人根本不会看这个设置，会一直用你选的那个值。

column2: Override it per environment. :: 按环境覆盖。
column3: You can override any setting, but each override is a place where the behaviour of production quietly differs from what the tests exercise. :: 任何设置都能覆盖，但每处覆盖都是生产行为和测试覆盖悄悄分叉的地方。

column2: The child class inherits the timeout. :: 子类继承了超时设置。
column3: Inheritance looked tidy until we realised that changing a method in the base class silently altered the behaviour of nine subclasses. :: 继承看起来很整洁，直到我们意识到修改基类的一个方法会悄悄改变九个子类的行为。

column2: A narrow interface is a gift. :: 窄接口是一份礼物。
column3: The interface stayed stable for three years while three different teams replaced everything behind it, which is the whole point of having one. :: 这个接口三年没变，期间三个团队把它背后的实现换了个遍，而这正是接口存在的意义。

column2: The callback runs after the write. :: 回调在写入之后执行。
column3: The callback fired twice because the retry logic did not know that the first request had actually succeeded. :: 回调触发了两次，因为重试逻辑不知道第一个请求其实已经成功了。

column2: Make the call async and await it. :: 把调用改成异步并 await。
column3: Making the handler async fixed the timeout, but it also meant every caller had to be rewritten, which took a week. :: 把处理函数改成异步解决了超时，但也意味着每个调用方都要重写，花了一周。

column2: Await the promise before reading. :: 读之前先 await。
column3: We forgot to await one promise in a background job, and the only symptom was a log line that occasionally appeared out of order. :: 我们在一个后台任务里忘了一个 await，唯一的症状是有时会出现顺序错乱的日志行。

column2: Concurrency makes this bug invisible. :: 并发让这个 bug 隐身。
column3: The bug only appeared under concurrency, so it survived six months of testing on a laptop where nothing ever ran in parallel. :: 这个 bug 只在并发下出现，于是在一台从不并行的笔记本上挺过了六个月的测试。

column2: Run the three checks in parallel. :: 三个检查并行跑。
column3: Running the tests in parallel cut the pipeline from nine minutes to three, and immediately exposed two tests that had been secretly depending on each other. :: 并行跑测试把流水线从九分钟降到三分钟，也立刻暴露出两个一直偷偷互相依赖的测试。

column2: The steps must stay sequential. :: 步骤必须保持顺序。
column3: Deploys are sequential by design: you migrate, you watch, you ship, and only then do you touch the next region. :: 部署在设计上就是串行的：先迁移，再观察，然后发布，最后才动下一个区域。

column2: A single thread handles the queue. :: 一个线程处理队列。
column3: The worker had one thread and a slow database, so the queue grew quietly for two hours before anyone noticed. :: 这个 worker 只有一个线程和一个慢数据库，队列悄悄增长了两个小时才有人注意到。

column2: The mutex protects the counter. :: 互斥锁保护计数器。
column3: Holding the mutex while calling the network turned the whole service into a single-file queue. :: 持锁期间调用网络，把整个服务变成了排队的一条线。

column2: The deadlock came from lock ordering. :: 死锁源于加锁顺序。
column3: Two engineers spent a day reading the same stack trace before someone noticed that the two workers acquired the same locks in opposite orders. :: 两个工程师看了一天的栈追踪，才有人发现两个 worker 以相反的顺序获取同一批锁。

column2: The write must be atomic. :: 写入必须是原子的。
column3: If the update is not atomic, a crash halfway through leaves the account in a state that no code knows how to repair. :: 如果更新不是原子的，中途崩溃就会让账户处于任何代码都不知道怎么修的状态。

column2: Wrap both updates in one transaction. :: 把两次更新包在一个事务里。
column3: The transaction was correct, but it held a row lock for four seconds while an external API call timed out inside it. :: 事务本身是对的，但它在一次外部 API 调用超时期间持有了四秒的行锁。

column2: Persist the state to disk. :: 把状态持久化到磁盘。
column3: The state lived in memory for a year, and losing it on every restart was treated as normal until a customer asked why their settings vanished. :: 状态在内存里放了一年，每次重启都丢失被当成正常现象，直到有客户问为什么设置没了。

column2: The query scans the whole table. :: 这个查询扫全表。
column3: The query was fast on a table with a thousand rows and unusable on the same table with ten million. :: 这个查询在千行表上很快，在同样结构的一千万行表上完全不能用。

column2: Add an index on the lookup column. :: 在查询列上加索引。
column3: Adding one index made the page load in forty milliseconds instead of four seconds, and nobody had looked at that query in two years. :: 加一个索引让页面从四秒变成四十毫秒，而这个查询已经两年没人看过了。

column2: The schema change needs a migration. :: 表结构变更需要迁移。
column3: Changing the schema was easy; the hard part was convincing three other teams that their nightly jobs would keep working afterwards. :: 改表结构不难，难的是说服另外三个团队他们的夜间任务之后还能正常运行。

column2: Run the migration before the deploy. :: 部署前先跑迁移。
column3: The migration ran for six hours on production while the team watched a dashboard and took turns fetching coffee. :: 迁移在生产环境跑了六小时，团队盯着看板、轮流去拿咖啡。

column2: The constraint prevents duplicates. :: 约束防止重复。
column3: The database constraint caught the duplicate that the application code had been quietly creating once a week for a year. :: 数据库约束抓住了一个重复写入，而应用代码已经在悄悄制造它一年了，每周一次。

column2: The join on two columns is slow. :: 两列 join 很慢。
column3: That join looked harmless in the query plan, but it turned a one-second report into a ninety-second one as the tables grew. :: 那个 join 在查询计划里看起来无害，但随着表增长，它把一秒的报告变成了九十秒。

column2: The cache hides the real latency. :: 缓存掩盖了真实延迟。
column3: We added a cache, everything got faster, and we learned nothing about the slow query until the cache was cold on Monday morning. :: 我们加了缓存，一切都变快了，直到周一早上缓存是冷的时候，我们才对那个慢查询有了点认识。

column2: Invalidate the cache on every write. :: 每次写入都让缓存失效。
column3: Invalidating too aggressively turned the cache into a very complicated way of adding latency to every request. :: 失效得太激进，等于把缓存变成了一种给每个请求增加延迟的复杂方式。

column2: The tokens expire after an hour. :: 令牌一小时后过期。
column3: Tokens expire after an hour, which is fine for users and mildly annoying for the batch job that runs every ninety minutes. :: 令牌一小时过期，对用户没问题，但对每九十分钟跑一次的批处理任务有点麻烦。

column2: Evict the least recently used entry. :: 淘汰最久未使用的条目。
column3: The cache evicted the one entry that every request needed, which is how we learned that "least recently used" is not the same as "least important". :: 缓存淘汰了每个请求都需要的那一条，我们因此学到「最久未使用」并不等于「最不重要」。

column2: Stale data confused the dashboard. :: 过期数据让看板失真。
column3: The dashboard showed stale numbers for twenty minutes, and the team spent those twenty minutes convinced that the deploy had broken everything. :: 看板显示了二十分钟的过期数据，团队就用这二十分钟认定部署把一切都弄坏了。

column2: Throttle the client to one call a second. :: 把客户端限流到每秒一次。
column3: We throttled the client and the errors disappeared, which told us the problem had been volume, not correctness. :: 我们给客户端限流后错误消失了，这说明问题是量太大，而不是逻辑错。

column2: Debounce the input by 200 ms. :: 对输入做 200 毫秒防抖。
column3: Debouncing the search box cut the request count by ninety percent and made the interface feel faster than the "instant" version ever had. :: 给搜索框加防抖把请求量降了九成，界面反而比那个「即时」版本感觉更快。

column2: Retry with jitter and a cap. :: 带抖动和上限地重试。
column3: Our first retry policy was so enthusiastic that a brief network blip turned into three thousand requests hitting an already struggling service. :: 我们最初的重试策略太热情，一次短暂网络抖动就变成了三千个请求砸向一个本来就在挣扎的服务。

column2: Exponential backoff softens the spike. :: 指数退避缓和尖峰。
column3: Backoff fixed the spike, but the first version waited so long that some requests took four minutes to fail. :: 退避解决了尖峰，但第一版等得太久，有些请求要四分钟才失败。

column2: Set a timeout on every call. :: 每个调用都设超时。
column3: A missing timeout turned a slow dependency into a total outage, because every worker was waiting forever on the same call. :: 缺一个超时把一个慢依赖变成了全面故障，因为每个 worker 都在同一个调用上永远等待。

column2: Idle time is when the bugs surface. :: 空闲时 bug 才浮现。
column3: The connection stayed idle for longer than the server allowed, so the first request after lunch always failed and always succeeded on retry. :: 连接空闲时间超过了服务端允许的上限，于是午饭后的第一个请求总是失败，重试又总是成功。

column2: Drain the queue before shutdown. :: 关机前排空队列。
column3: A queue that grows faster than it drains looks fine for a week and then becomes the only thing anyone talks about. :: 一个增长快于消费的队列，会在一周内看起来正常，然后成为所有人唯一在谈的事。

column2: Grow the buffer for slow consumers. :: 为慢消费者扩大缓冲区。
column3: The buffer absorbed the spike, but it also hid the fact that one consumer was ten times slower than the others. :: 缓冲区吸收了尖峰，也掩盖了一个消费者比其他慢十倍的事实。

column2: Stream the response instead of buffering. :: 流式返回而不是缓冲。
column3: Streaming the export let users see the first rows in a second, which changed the complaint from "it hangs" to "it is a bit slow". :: 流式导出让用户一秒内看到前几行，抱怨从「卡死」变成了「有点慢」。

column2: Process the events in batches of a hundred. :: 每批一百条处理事件。
column3: Batching cut the writes from ten thousand to a hundred, and the database stopped complaining within the hour. :: 批处理把写入从一万次降到一百次，数据库一小时内就不抱怨了。

column2: Split the upload into 5 MB chunks. :: 把上传拆成 5MB 分片。
column3: Chunking the upload made retries cheap, because a failure only cost five megabytes instead of the whole file. :: 分片上传让重试变便宜，失败一次只损失五兆而不是整个文件。

column2: The payload exceeds the size limit. :: 负载超过大小限制。
column3: The payload doubled when we added tracing headers, which nobody noticed until the gateway started rejecting requests at exactly the limit. :: 加了追踪头以后负载翻倍，直到网关开始在恰好那个上限拒绝请求才有人发现。

column2: The auth header is missing. :: 缺少认证头。
column3: One service sent the header with a capital letter and the other expected lowercase, and the two argued about it for a day. :: 一个服务发送的头首字母大写，另一个期望小写，两边为此争了一天。

column2: The status code says it all. :: 状态码说明一切。
column3: We returned 200 for every failure because it was easier, and then spent a month wondering why the client never retried anything. :: 我们把所有失败都返回 200，因为这样省事，然后花一个月想不通客户端为什么从不重试。

column2: The response is cached for a minute. :: 响应缓存一分钟。
column3: A response that took four seconds to build was being requested forty times a minute by a single user's dashboard. :: 一个要四秒才能构建的响应，被同一个用户的看板每分钟请求四十次。

column2: Every request carries a trace id. :: 每个请求都带追踪 id。
column3: The request looked identical to the thousand before it, except that this one arrived while the cache was being rebuilt. :: 这个请求和之前那一千个看起来一模一样，区别只是它到达时缓存正在重建。

column2: The endpoint rejects unsigned calls. :: 接口拒绝未签名调用。
column3: That endpoint has been deprecated for two years, but four internal tools still call it every night at three in the morning. :: 这个接口两年前就废弃了，但仍有四个内部工具每天凌晨三点调用它。

column2: The route matches on method and path. :: 路由按方法和路径匹配。
column3: One route handled both the webhooks and the health checks, which meant a slow health check could block a payment notification. :: 一个路由同时处理 webhook 和健康检查，结果一个慢的健康检查能堵住支付通知。

column2: The handler returns a plain object. :: 处理函数返回普通对象。
column3: The handler swallowed every exception and returned an empty list, so the first sign of trouble was a customer asking where their data went. :: 处理函数吞掉了所有异常并返回空列表，于是问题的第一个信号是客户来问数据去哪了。

column2: Auth lives in one middleware. :: 认证放在一个中间件里。
column3: Putting authentication in a middleware sounded clean until we needed two routes with different rules and had to special-case both. :: 把认证放进中间件听起来很干净，直到我们有两个规则不同的路由，只能给两边都写特例。

column2: The proxy adds the tracing header. :: 代理添加追踪头。
column3: The proxy was supposed to be transparent, but it rewrote every response body and quietly broke binary downloads. :: 代理本该是透明的，但它重写了每个响应体，悄悄弄坏了二进制下载。

column2: The gateway terminates TLS. :: 网关终结 TLS。
column3: All traffic went through one gateway, so one misconfigured rule took down every service at the same moment. :: 所有流量都走一个网关，于是一条配错的规则在同一瞬间让所有服务下线。

column2: The socket stays open for push events. :: 套接字为推送事件保持打开。
column3: The socket reconnected every thirty seconds because a load balancer in the middle had a shorter idle timeout than we assumed. :: 套接字每三十秒重连一次，因为中间那个负载均衡器的空闲超时比我们以为的短。

column2: The TLS handshake costs one round trip. :: TLS 握手要一次往返。
column3: The handshake dominated the latency for small requests, which is why the new client keeps connections alive between calls. :: 对小请求来说握手占了大部分延迟，所以新客户端在调用之间保持连接。

column2: The extra hop adds 20 ms. :: 多一跳增加 20 毫秒。
column3: Latency looked fine on average and terrible at the ninety-ninth percentile, which is the number the paying customers actually experience. :: 平均延迟看起来不错，但 99 分位很糟，而付费用户实际体验到的正是那个数字。

column2: Throughput doubled after the fix. :: 修复后吞吐翻倍。
column3: Throughput doubled when we stopped holding a lock during the network call, and the p99 barely moved. :: 我们不再在网络调用期间持锁后，吞吐翻倍了，而 p99 几乎没变。

column2: Compression saves bandwidth. :: 压缩节省带宽。
column3: Saving bandwidth mattered less than we expected; the release was slow because of sixty tiny requests, not one big one. :: 省带宽没我们想的那么重要：发布慢是因为六十个小请求，而不是一个大请求。

column2: Run the benchmark on every commit. :: 每次提交跑基准。
column3: The benchmark was honest for a month, then someone changed the machine and we spent two weeks chasing a regression that did not exist. :: 基准测试诚实了一个月，然后有人换了机器，我们花两周追一个并不存在的回归。

column2: Profile before you optimize. :: 优化之前先剖析。
column3: The profile said the slow part was logging, and we had spent a week optimizing a function that never appeared in the top ten. :: 剖析显示慢在日志，而我们花一周优化了一个从没进过前十的函数。

column2: Optimize the query, not the hardware. :: 优化查询，不是硬件。
column3: We optimized for the benchmark and accidentally made the common case slower, which took a customer to notice. :: 我们照着基准优化，却意外让常见情况变慢了，还是一个客户发现的。

column2: The single writer is the bottleneck. :: 唯一写入者是瓶颈。
column3: Everyone assumed the database was the bottleneck until someone measured and found the lock in our own code. :: 所有人都以为瓶颈在数据库，直到有人实测发现锁在我们自己的代码里。

column2: The wrapper adds negligible overhead. :: 包装层开销可忽略。
column3: The overhead was three microseconds per call, which sounds like nothing until you multiply it by forty million calls a day. :: 每次调用三微秒的开销听起来不算什么，直到你把它乘以每天四千万次调用。

column2: The tool has a tiny footprint. :: 这个工具占用很小。
column3: Memory footprint grew slowly for a year, and the only visible symptom was a container that restarted every few days. :: 内存占用一年里慢慢增长，唯一可见的症状是容器每隔几天重启一次。

column2: The design is scalable but complex. :: 设计可扩展但复杂。
column3: A design can be scalable and still be wrong: ours scaled to ten times the traffic and made every debugging session ten times harder. :: 一个设计可以既可扩展又错误：我们的扩展到了十倍流量，也让每次调试难了十倍。

column2: The system is resilient to node loss. :: 系统能扛节点丢失。
column3: The system survived losing a node, but only because the retry budget happened to be large enough that nobody noticed the extra latency. :: 系统扛住了一个节点丢失，但这只是因为重试预算恰好够大，没人注意到额外的延迟。

column2: Drop the redundant validation. :: 去掉多余的校验。
column3: The validation was redundant, but deleting it removed the only place that logged why a malformed request had been rejected. :: 这个校验确实多余，但删掉它也就删掉了唯一记录畸形请求为什么被拒的地方。

column2: Failover took four seconds. :: 故障转移用了四秒。
column3: Failover worked exactly as designed, which is why nobody had noticed that the standby had been broken for months. :: 故障转移完全按设计工作，也正因如此，没人发现备用节点已经坏了好几个月。

column2: We promise 99.9 percent uptime. :: 我们承诺 99.9% 可用性。
column3: Ninety-nine point nine percent sounds generous until you do the arithmetic and realise it allows forty-three minutes of downtime a month. :: 99.9% 听起来很慷慨，直到你算一下才发现它允许每月四十三分钟的不可用。

column2: The outage lasted seven minutes. :: 中断持续七分钟。
column3: The outage lasted seven minutes and produced three weeks of meetings, which is roughly the ratio you should expect. :: 中断持续七分钟，产出了三周的会议，这个比例大概是你该预期的。

column2: The service is up but degraded. :: 服务还在但降级。
column3: The service ran in a degraded mode for a day: correct answers, but each one took four seconds longer than it should. :: 服务降级运行了一天：答案都对，但每个都慢了四秒。

column2: The incident review is tomorrow. :: 事故复盘在明天。
column3: The incident review was blameless on paper and slightly tense in practice, because everyone knew who had merged the change. :: 复盘在纸面上不追责，实际上有点紧张，因为大家都知道是谁合并的那个改动。

column2: Label the severity first. :: 先标严重程度。
column3: We argued about severity for twenty minutes while the site was still down, which is exactly the wrong order to do things in. :: 站点还挂着的时候我们争了二十分钟严重程度，这个顺序完全反了。

column2: The alert fired three times last night. :: 昨晚告警触发三次。
column3: The alert fired every night at the same time, and after a month someone finally asked what the job at three in the morning was even for. :: 告警每晚同一时间触发，一个月后才有人问凌晨三点那个任务到底是干嘛的。

column2: The test asserts the exact string. :: 测试断言确切字符串。
column3: The assertion compared the whole response body, so a harmless timestamp change broke the test every night. :: 断言比较了整个响应体，于是每次时间戳变化都会让测试在夜里挂掉。

column2: The fixture builds a fake user. :: 夹具构造假用户。
column3: The fixture created a user with a fixed id, which worked until two tests ran in parallel and fought over the same row. :: 夹具用固定 id 创建用户，一直没事，直到两个测试并行跑、抢同一行数据。

column2: Mock the network in the unit test. :: 单元测试里模拟网络。
column3: Mocking the network made the test fast and completely blind to the one thing that broke in production. :: 模拟网络让测试很快，也让它对生产里唯一坏掉的那件事完全瞎了。

column2: Replace the stub with a real client. :: 用真实客户端替换桩。
column3: The stub returned a perfect response for two years, and the first real call failed because the field was nullable. :: 桩两年来都返回完美响应，第一个真实调用却因为那个字段可为空而失败。

column2: Coverage is a weak signal. :: 覆盖率是弱信号。
column3: Coverage went up by ten percent after we added tests that asserted nothing, which is exactly the problem with measuring lines. :: 我们加了一批什么都不测的测试后覆盖率涨了十个百分点，这正是按行衡量的毛病。

column2: The release introduced a regression. :: 这版引入了回归。
column3: A regression that nobody could reproduce locally turned out to depend on the user's time zone, which was the one variable nobody had thought to set. :: 一个本地复现不了的回归，最后发现取决于用户的时区，而那是唯一没人想到要设置的变量。

column2: Reproduce it before you fix it. :: 修之前先复现。
column3: If you cannot reproduce the bug, you cannot tell whether your fix did anything, and you will find out from a customer instead. :: 如果复现不了，你就无法判断修复有没有用，最后只能从客户那里得知结果。

column2: The trace shows a hidden retry. :: 追踪记录显示隐藏重试。
column3: Reading the trace from the end backwards is usually faster: start at the error and walk up until the first surprise. :: 从后往前读追踪记录通常更快：从错误开始往上走，直到遇见第一个意外。

column2: Run it with verbose logging. :: 用详细日志运行。
column3: Verbose logging found the bug in ten minutes and then filled the disk in an hour, because someone left it on in production. :: 详细日志十分钟就找到了 bug，然后一小时就把磁盘写满，因为有人在生产里忘了关。

column2: Debug the failure path first. :: 先调试失败路径。
column3: Debugging this is easier if you remember that the happy path has never once been the problem. :: 如果你记得顺路径从来不是问题所在，调试这个就简单多了。

column2: Set a breakpoint in the handler. :: 在处理函数里设断点。
column3: A breakpoint in the retry loop told us more in five minutes than an afternoon of reading logs had. :: 在重试循环里设一个断点，五分钟告诉我们的事比读一下午日志还多。

column2: The stack trace points at line 42. :: 栈追踪指向第 42 行。
column3: The stack trace was forty frames deep and the actual mistake was in the first line of our own code. :: 栈追踪有四十层深，而真正的错误在我们自己代码的第一行。

column2: A heap allocation shows up in the profile. :: 堆分配会出现在剖析里。
column3: The heap grew by a megabyte a minute, which is slow enough to hide for a week and fast enough to matter. :: 堆每分钟增长一兆，慢到能藏一周，快到确实要命。

column2: A slow leak killed the pod overnight. :: 慢泄漏一夜拖死容器。
column3: The leak was two objects per request, invisible in any single test and fatal after a hundred thousand requests. :: 泄漏是每请求两个对象，单次测试看不出来，十万次请求之后致命。

column2: Garbage collection pauses for 50 ms. :: 垃圾回收停顿 50 毫秒。
column3: Garbage collection pauses were short but frequent, and together they explained most of the latency users complained about. :: 垃圾回收的停顿时长很短但很频繁，加起来正好解释了用户抱怨的大部分延迟。

column2: Parse the input with a strict grammar. :: 用严格文法解析输入。
column3: The parser accepted a slightly malformed file for years, then rejected it the day a customer started generating it automatically. :: 解析器多年来接受一个略畸形的文件，直到有客户开始自动生成它那天才拒绝。

column2: The token expires in an hour. :: 令牌一小时过期。
column3: Every token in the logs had been redacted except one, which had been printed by an error message nobody had reviewed. :: 日志里的令牌都被脱敏了，只有一个例外：它是被一条没人评审过的报错打印出来的。

column2: The syntax error is a missing brace. :: 语法错误是少了个大括号。
column3: One missing brace cost three engineers half a day, mostly because the compiler pointed at a line that was entirely correct. :: 一个缺失的大括号花了三个工程师半天，主要因为编译器指向的那一行完全正确。

column2: A semantic change breaks compatibility. :: 语义变更破坏兼容性。
column3: The version number did not change, but the semantics of the field did, and every client that trusted it broke quietly. :: 版本号没变，但字段语义变了，每个信任它的客户端都悄悄坏了。

column2: Rename the variable to match its meaning. :: 把变量重命名成符合语义。
column3: A variable called `data` held the retry count for two years, and every new engineer read the code wrong at least once. :: 一个叫 `data` 的变量装了两年的重试次数，每个新工程师至少读错过一次。

column2: Extract the magic number into a constant. :: 把魔法数字提取成常量。
column3: The constant was defined in three places with two different values, and the bug only appeared when the third one was used. :: 这个常量在三个地方定义、有两个不同的值，bug 只在用到第三个时出现。

column2: Prefer constants over bare literals. :: 优先用常量而不是裸字面量。
column3: A literal `86400` appeared forty times in the codebase, and one of them meant something else entirely. :: 代码里 `86400` 出现了四十次，其中一个的含义完全不同。

column2: Shared mutable state causes bugs. :: 共享可变状态引发 bug。
column3: The mutable list was shared between requests, so one slow user's data sometimes appeared in another user's response. :: 这个可变列表在请求之间共享，于是某个慢用户的数据有时出现在别人的响应里。

column2: Immutable data is easier to reason about. :: 不可变数据更易推理。
column3: Making the config immutable removed a whole class of bugs, at the cost of rebuilding it once per request. :: 把配置改成不可变消除了一整类 bug，代价是每请求重建一次。

column2: A null pointer ended the run. :: 一个空指针结束了这次运行。
column3: The pointer was valid when we checked it and invalid by the time we used it, a gap of four lines. :: 我们检查时指针还有效，等用到时已经失效，中间只隔了四行。

column2: Pass the object by reference. :: 按引用传递对象。
column3: Passing by reference was faster and meant that the callee could quietly change data the caller still believed it owned. :: 按引用传递更快，也意味着被调用方能悄悄修改调用方以为还属于自己数据。

column2: Allocate the buffer once and reuse it. :: 分配一次并复用缓冲。
column3: Allocating inside the loop was fine for a thousand iterations and fatal at a million, which is where it actually ran. :: 在循环里分配在一千次迭代时没问题，到百万次就致命，而它实际就是跑百万次。

column2: Initialize the client lazily. :: 懒初始化客户端。
column3: The client was initialized before the config was loaded, so every connection went to the default host for the first minute. :: 客户端在配置加载之前就初始化了，于是第一分钟所有连接都打到默认主机。

column2: Instantiate one client per process. :: 每进程实例化一个客户端。
column3: We instantiated a client per request because it looked cheap, and the connection pool disagreed within an hour. :: 我们每请求实例化一个客户端，因为看起来便宜，一小时内连接池就表示了不同意见。

column2: Invoke the handler only once. :: 只调用一次处理函数。
column3: The handler was invoked twice because two systems both believed they owned the retry. :: 处理函数被调用了两次，因为两个系统都认为重试归自己管。

column2: The exception is swallowed silently. :: 异常被悄悄吞掉。
column3: One swallowed exception hid a failing migration for a week, and the only clue was a count that was slightly too low. :: 一个被吞掉的异常掩盖了一周的迁移失败，唯一的线索是一个略偏低的数量。

column2: Catch specific errors, not everything. :: 捕获具体错误而不是全部。
column3: Catching everything meant the process stayed alive while quietly doing the wrong thing for hours. :: 捕获一切意味着进程活着，却在几小时里安静地做错事。

column2: Throw a typed error with a code. :: 抛出带错误码的类型化错误。
column3: Throwing a string was quick to write and impossible to handle, since every caller had to parse the message. :: 抛字符串写起来快，但无法处理，因为每个调用方都得解析消息文本。

column2: Validate at the boundary only. :: 只在边界校验。
column3: Validating the same field in five layers felt safe and made every change five times more expensive. :: 在五层里校验同一个字段感觉安全，也让每次改动贵了五倍。

column2: Sanitize the input before rendering. :: 渲染前清洗输入。
column3: Sanitizing on the way out protected the page, but the raw value was already stored and later mailed to a customer. :: 输出时清洗保护了页面，但原始值已经存下来，后来还被发给了客户。

column2: Escape the HTML entities. :: 转义 HTML 实体。
column3: The escaping was correct; the bug was that the data went into a JavaScript string instead of HTML. :: 转义本身没错，问题在于数据进了 JavaScript 字符串而不是 HTML。

column2: Encode the key with base64url. :: 用 base64url 编码键。
column3: The key was encoded once when stored and again when read, so every lookup quietly used a different string. :: 键存的时候编码一次，读的时候又编码一次，于是每次查询用的都是不同的字符串。

column2: Decode the payload before logging it. :: 记录日志前先解码。
column3: Decoding for the logs was convenient, and it also put customer names into a system that was not supposed to hold them. :: 为了日志解码很方便，也把客户名字放进了一个本不该存它们的系统。

column2: Serialize the state as JSON. :: 状态序列化成 JSON。
column3: Serializing with the default encoder lost the time zone, which nobody noticed until reports started arriving an hour early. :: 用默认编码器序列化丢了时区，直到报告开始早一小时才有人发现。

column2: Deserialize only trusted input. :: 只反序列化可信输入。
column3: Deserializing the cached blob was fast, and it also meant a corrupted cache could crash the service on restart. :: 反序列化缓存很快，也意味着一个损坏的缓存能让服务重启即崩。

column2: Hash the password with a salt. :: 加盐哈希密码。
column3: The hash was strong; the reset flow still emailed the password in plain text, which made the hash irrelevant. :: 哈希本身很强，但重置流程仍在邮件里发明文密码，哈希就变得无关紧要了。

column2: Encrypt the token at rest. :: 静态存储时加密令牌。
column3: Encrypting at rest was required by policy, and the key was stored in the same repository as the data. :: 策略要求静态加密，而密钥就存在放数据的同一个仓库里。

column2: Decrypt in memory only. :: 只在内存里解密。
column3: Decrypting once per request cost four milliseconds, which was acceptable until the endpoint started receiving a thousand requests a second. :: 每请求解密一次要四毫秒，本来可以接受，直到这个接口开始每秒收一千个请求。

column2: Verify the signature before parsing. :: 解析前验证签名。
column3: The signature check was skipped on the internal route, which was fine until someone exposed that route to the internet. :: 内部路由跳过了签名校验，本来没事，直到有人把它暴露到公网。

column2: Authenticate with a signed header. :: 用签名头认证。
column3: Authenticating the request was easy; deciding which of three services should do it took a week of meetings. :: 认证请求本身不难，难的是决定三个服务里该由谁做，开了一周会。

column2: Authorize the action, not just the user. :: 授权动作，不只是用户。
column3: The service authorized the user correctly and let them delete a record they could only read, which is a distinction worth testing. :: 服务正确校验了用户身份，却让他们删掉了一条只有读权限的记录，这个区别值得写测试。

column2: Rotate the credentials every ninety days. :: 每九十天轮换凭证。
column3: Rotating credentials is a chore until the day you actually need to do it during an incident. :: 轮换凭证是件琐事，直到事故当天你真的需要在那种时候做它。

column2: The permission is scoped to one repo. :: 权限只限一个仓库。
column3: The permission was broad enough to be convenient and broad enough that a stolen token could read every repository we owned. :: 这个权限宽到很方便，也宽到一旦令牌泄露就能读我们所有仓库。

column2: Keep the scope of the change small. :: 把改动范围控制住。
column3: Scope creep is rarely one big decision; it is forty small ones, each of which made sense at the time. :: 范围蔓延很少是一个大决定，而是四十个小决定，每一个当时都合理。

column2: The role can read but not write. :: 该角色可读不可写。
column3: Adding one more role to the model felt harmless until it interacted with two existing roles in ways nobody had tested. :: 在模型里多加一个角色看似无害，直到它和两个已有角色产生了没人测过的交互。

column2: The policy blocks force pushes. :: 策略禁止强制推送。
column3: The policy was written after an incident, and by the time it was approved the incident had already been forgotten. :: 这条策略是事故之后写的，等它被批准时那次事故已经被忘掉了。

column2: The audit log keeps every change. :: 审计日志保留每次改动。
column3: The audit log was complete, which is how we discovered that the same engineer had been fixing the same bug every month for a year. :: 审计日志很完整，我们因此发现同一个工程师一年来每个月都在修同一个 bug。

column2: Compliance review takes a week. :: 合规评审要一周。
column3: Compliance asked for four documents, and three of them described behaviour that had changed two releases ago. :: 合规要了四份文档，其中三份描述的行为两个版本前就改了。

column2: The old parser is vulnerable to crafted input. :: 旧解析器对构造输入有漏洞。
column3: The library was vulnerable for eighteen months, and the fix was one line that nobody had time to review. :: 这个库有漏洞十八个月，修复是一行代码，只是没人有时间去评审。

column2: The bug is hard to exploit but real. :: 漏洞难利用但确实存在。
column3: Nobody could exploit it in practice, and we patched it anyway because "hard" is not the same as "impossible". :: 实际上没人能利用它，我们还是打了补丁，因为「难」不等于「不可能」。

column2: Mitigate the risk with a rate limit. :: 用限流缓解风险。
column3: Rate limiting mitigated the symptom while the actual bug sat in the queue for another month. :: 限流缓解了症状，而真正的 bug 又在队列里躺了一个月。

column2: The feature ships behind a flag. :: 功能在开关后面发布。
column3: A feature nobody enabled is a feature nobody can complain about, which is why the default matters more than the code. :: 没人打开的功能就没人抱怨，这正是为什么默认值比代码本身更重要。

column2: Write the requirement as a test. :: 把需求写成测试。
column3: The requirement was two sentences long and produced four pages of discussion about what "immediately" means. :: 需求只有两句话，却引出了四页关于「立即」是什么意思的讨论。

column2: The specification leaves one case open. :: 规范留了一个情况没定。
column3: The specification was clear on every happy path and silent on exactly the case that broke first in production. :: 规范在每条顺路径上都很清楚，偏偏对生产里最先出问题的那个情况沉默。

column2: The milestone slipped by a week. :: 里程碑晚了一周。
column3: Every milestone slipped by a week, and the total was never as bad as the individual weeks suggested. :: 每个里程碑都晚一周，总计却没有那一周一周加起来那么糟。

column2: The deadline is Friday noon. :: 截止时间是周五中午。
column3: The deadline moved twice and both times nobody wrote down who had agreed to the new one. :: 截止时间改了两次，两次都没人记下来是谁同意的。

column2: The sprint ends on Wednesday. :: 迭代周三结束。
column3: The sprint had eleven items and finished four, which was the moment we started measuring differently. :: 这个迭代排了十一项、完成四项，从那一刻起我们开始换了一种度量方式。

column2: The backlog is full of small fixes. :: 待办里全是小修。
column3: The backlog grew faster than we closed it for a year, and the only honest metric was how many items we deleted without doing. :: 一年里待办增长快于清空，唯一诚实的指标是我们删掉了多少没做的条目。

column2: Open a ticket with the steps. :: 带着复现步骤开工单。
column3: The ticket said "it does not work" and nothing else, so the first hour went into asking what "it" was. :: 工单只写了「它不工作」，别的什么都没有，第一小时就花在问「它」是什么上。

column2: Assign one owner per task. :: 每个任务一个负责人。
column3: Every task had four owners and therefore none, which is why three of them were still open a quarter later. :: 每个任务有四个负责人、等于没有，所以三个月后还有三个挂在那。

column2: The top priority is the leak. :: 最高优先级是修泄漏。
column3: The priority list changed every morning, which meant nothing on it was actually a priority. :: 优先级列表每天早上都改，意味着上面没有一件事真的是优先级。

column2: The estimate was off by a factor of two. :: 估算差了一倍。
column3: Every estimate was optimistic by the same factor, and after a year we finally started multiplying by two. :: 每个估算都同样的乐观，一年后我们终于开始乘以二。

column2: The review is the only blocker. :: 评审是唯一阻塞项。
column3: Calling something a blocker is easy; the useful part is saying who needs to do what so it stops being one. :: 把一个东西叫做阻塞项很容易，有用的是说清谁该做什么才能解除它。

column2: Every design is a tradeoff. :: 每个设计都是取舍。
column3: The tradeoff was real and we documented it, which is why the next team could make the same decision in ten minutes. :: 这个取舍真实存在，而且我们记录了下来，所以下一个团队能十分钟做出同样的决定。

column2: The proposal needs two approvals. :: 提案需要两个批准。
column3: The proposal was eleven pages long and the decision was made after reading the summary in the first paragraph. :: 提案有十一页，决定是在读完第一段摘要之后做的。

column2: The change is waiting for approval. :: 变更在等批准。
column3: Approval took four days, and the change itself took twenty minutes once someone looked at it. :: 批准花了四天，而改动本身在有人看之后只花了二十分钟。

column2: Short feedback loops are precious. :: 短反馈循环很宝贵。
column3: Feedback that arrives a week later is a review; feedback that arrives in a minute is a conversation. :: 一周后到的反馈是评审，一分钟内到的反馈是对话。

column2: The suggestion made the diff smaller. :: 这条建议让 diff 变小了。
column3: The suggestion was two words in a comment, and it removed an entire branch of the implementation. :: 建议只是评论里的两个词，却删掉了实现里的一整条分支。

column2: Simplify before you generalize. :: 先简化再抽象。
column3: We simplified the API by removing one parameter, and it turned out forty callers had been passing it incorrectly anyway. :: 我们删掉一个参数来简化 API，结果发现四十个调用方本来就在传错。

column2: Clarify the error message. :: 把报错说清楚。
column3: The error said "invalid input", which is true of every error ever and helped nobody debug anything. :: 报错只写「输入无效」，这句话对任何错误都成立，帮不上任何忙。

column2: Document the why, not the what. :: 记录为什么而非做什么。
column3: Nothing was documented, so the only way to learn why the check existed was to remove it and see what broke. :: 什么都没写文档，所以想搞清楚这个检查为什么存在，唯一办法是删掉它看什么坏了。

column2: The changelog lists the breaking change. :: 更新日志列出破坏性变更。
column3: The changelog was accurate and nobody read it, which is why four teams were surprised by the same breaking change. :: 更新日志写得很准，但没人读，于是四个团队被同一个破坏性变更打了措手不及。

column2: The release ships on Friday. :: 版本周五发布。
column3: The release was ready on Wednesday and we spent two days debating whether to ship before or after the weekend. :: 周三就准备好了，我们花两天争论该在周末前还是后发布。

column2: Pin the version for reproducible builds. :: 锁定版本以复现构建。
column3: Two versions of the same library were installed in the same process, and the one that won depended on import order. :: 同一个进程里装了两个版本的同一个库，谁生效取决于导入顺序。

column2: Deprecate the field before removing it. :: 移除字段前先标记弃用。
column3: We deprecated the endpoint with a warning, waited two releases, and still broke four clients that ignored the warning. :: 我们带着警告废弃了这个接口，等了两个版本，还是弄坏了四个无视警告的客户端。

column2: Backward compatibility has a price. :: 向后兼容有代价。
column3: Backward compatibility kept the old field alive for three years, and by the end nobody remembered what it was for. :: 向后兼容让这个旧字段活了三年，到最后没人记得它是干嘛的。

column2: Upgrade one dependency at a time. :: 一次升级一个依赖。
column3: We upgraded everything at once and spent a week bisecting which of the nineteen packages had changed behaviour. :: 我们一次性升级了所有依赖，然后花一周二分定位十九个包里是哪个改了行为。

column2: Downgrade if the metric regresses. :: 指标回归就降级。
column3: Downgrading fixed the regression and reintroduced the bug we had fixed two releases earlier. :: 降级修好了回归，也带回了两个版本前修好的那个 bug。

column2: Announce the change before the deploy. :: 部署前先宣布变更。
column3: The announcement went out after the deploy, which meant the first report of trouble came from a customer rather than a colleague. :: 公告在部署之后才发，于是第一个报告问题的是客户而不是同事。

column2: Notify the on-call engineer. :: 通知值班工程师。
column3: The system notified nobody, so the outage was discovered by a customer in a different time zone. :: 系统没有通知任何人，于是故障是一个在别的时区的客户发现的。

column2: Mention the workaround in the README. :: 在 README 里提绕行方案。
column3: The workaround was mentioned in a comment on a closed issue, which is the same as not documenting it. :: 绕行方案写在一个已关闭 issue 的评论里，等于没有记录。

column2: Summarize the incident in five lines. :: 五行总结事故。
column3: If you cannot summarize an incident in five lines, you probably do not understand it yet. :: 如果五行总结不了一次事故，多半是你还没搞懂它。

column2: Outline the plan before coding. :: 写代码前先概述计划。
column3: The outline was three bullets, and writing it saved us from building the wrong thing for two days. :: 大纲只有三条,写它让我们免于花两天做错东西。

column2: Test the worst-case scenario. :: 测试最坏情况。
column3: We tested the worst case and shipped the average one, which is where the bug lived. :: 我们测了最坏情况，发布了平均情况，而 bug 就住在平均情况里。

column2: The usage example is clear. :: 用法示例很清楚。
column3: The usage example worked because it used a different version of the library than the installation guide. :: 用法示例能跑，因为它用的库版本和安装指南里的不一样。

column2: Follow the guideline or change it. :: 要么遵守指南，要么改它。
column3: A guideline nobody follows is worse than no guideline, because it makes every reader think the rules are optional. :: 没人遵守的指南比没有指南更糟，因为它让每个读者都以为规则是可选的。

column2: Follow the naming convention. :: 遵守命名约定。
column3: The convention was inconsistent for two files out of four hundred, and those two caused most of the confusion. :: 四百个文件里有两个不守约定，大部分困惑都来自那两个。

column2: Consistency beats cleverness. :: 一致性胜过聪明。
column3: Consistency is boring until you are debugging at midnight and do not have to guess which of three styles this file uses. :: 一致性很无聊，直到你半夜调 bug 时不用猜这个文件用的是三种风格里的哪一种。

column2: Clarity is the real feature. :: 清晰才是真功能。
column3: The code was clever and correct, and it took three engineers to work out what it did before anyone dared to change it. :: 这段代码聪明且正确，在有人敢改它之前，花了三个工程师才看明白它在做什么。

column2: Improve readability before you optimize. :: 优化之前先提升可读性。
column3: Readability improved when we deleted a third of the code, which had been kept because someone might need it one day. :: 我们删掉三分之一的代码后可读性提升了，那些代码当初留着是因为「也许有天要用」。

column2: Small modules improve maintainability. :: 小模块提升可维护性。
column3: Maintainability is what you pay for later, and the interest compounds quietly every time someone reads the file. :: 可维护性是以后付的账，每次有人读这个文件，利息都在悄悄累积。

column2: Prefer simplicity over flexibility. :: 优先简单而非灵活。
column3: Simplicity was the only reason the system could be understood by someone who had not written it, which happened within a month. :: 正是因为简单，没写过这套系统的人也能看懂，而这只用了一个月就成为现实。

column2: Complexity hides in the configuration. :: 复杂度藏在配置里。
column3: The complexity was not in the code but in the nineteen ways the configuration could be combined. :: 复杂度不在代码里，而在配置可以组合出的十九种方式里。

column2: Loose coupling keeps deploys independent. :: 松耦合让部署独立。
column3: Tight coupling meant that changing a colour required deploying three services, one of which nobody owned any more. :: 紧耦合意味着改个颜色要部署三个服务，其中一个已经没人负责了。

column2: High cohesion makes files readable. :: 高内聚让文件好读。
column3: High cohesion was the reason we could delete the module in an afternoon without hunting for its other halves. :: 正因为高内聚，我们一个下午就能删掉这个模块，不用到处找它的另一半。

column2: The codebase is modular and testable. :: 代码库模块化且可测。
column3: Making it modular took a month and paid for itself the first time we replaced one piece without touching the rest. :: 模块化花了一个月，第一次单独替换某一块而不用动其他部分时就回本了。

column2: A reusable hook saves duplication. :: 可复用的 hook 减少重复。
column3: The reusable component was reused exactly once, in a place where copying it would have been clearer. :: 这个可复用组件只被复用过一次，而且在那个地方，直接复制反而更清楚。

column2: The generator removes the boilerplate. :: 生成器去掉样板代码。
column3: Boilerplate is cheap to write and expensive to read, which is why generators earn their keep in a large codebase. :: 样板代码写起来便宜、读起来昂贵，这正是生成器在大代码库里值得存在的原因。

column2: Use the template for new issues. :: 新建 issue 用模板。
column3: The template asked for reproduction steps, and the reports that ignored it were exactly the ones we could not act on. :: 模板要求填复现步骤，而忽略它的那些报告恰好都是我们无法处理的。

column2: Save the snippet for later reuse. :: 保存片段以便复用。
column3: The snippet was copied from a blog post in 2019, and the blog post had been wrong even then. :: 这段代码是从 2019 年的一篇博客里抄的，而那篇博客在当时就已经是错的。

column2: Learn one shortcut a day. :: 每天学一个快捷键。
column3: The shortcut saved two seconds and cost a new engineer ten minutes of confusion, which is a trade worth knowing about. :: 这个快捷键省两秒，却让新工程师困惑十分钟，这个取舍值得知道。

column2: Set a keybinding for the drill. :: 给训练设一个键位。
column3: The keybinding conflicted with one that another plugin had already taken, and the winner depended on load order. :: 这个键位和另一个插件已经占用的冲突了，谁生效取决于加载顺序。

column2: Open the drill in a split pane. :: 在分屏里打开训练。
column3: The pane was two hundred columns wide and the card still looked lost in the middle of it. :: 这个窗格有二百列宽，卡片放在中间仍然显得空荡。

column2: The overlay does not steal focus. :: 浮层不抢焦点。
column3: The overlay covered the exact line the user was reading, which is the one thing an overlay should never do. :: 浮层正好盖住了用户在读的那一行，这恰恰是浮层最不该做的事。

column2: The popup is 60 columns wide. :: 弹窗宽 60 列。
column3: The popup felt instant and closed slowly, which is backwards: you notice the exit far more than the entrance. :: 弹窗打开很快、关闭很慢，正好反了：离开比进入更让人在意。

column2: A notification appeared after ten minutes. :: 十分钟后出现通知。
column3: The notification arrived at the moment the user had finally started concentrating, which is how you teach people to mute you. :: 通知到的时机正是用户终于开始专注的那一刻，这就是在教人把你静音。

column2: The review interval grows with each success. :: 每次答对间隔变长。
column3: The interval doubled three times in a month, which is exactly how a word you learned once quietly leaves your life. :: 间隔一个月翻了三倍，一个只学过一次的词就是这样悄悄离开你的生活。

column2: Spaced repetition beats rereading. :: 间隔重复胜过反复阅读。
column3: Repetition feels good and does very little; the effort of recall is what actually moves the word into memory. :: 重复让人感觉良好但作用很小，真正把词写进记忆的是回忆时的那份吃力。

column2: Retention improves with active recall. :: 主动回忆提升记忆保持。
column3: Retention improved when we stopped showing the answer first, which felt slower and worked better. :: 我们不再先给答案后，记忆保持变好了，虽然感觉更慢。

column2: Active recall is the core drill. :: 主动回忆是核心训练。
column3: Recall is uncomfortable precisely because it is doing the work that makes the memory stick. :: 回忆之所以不舒服，正因为它做的就是让记忆留存的那份工作。

column2: Fluency grows from daily practice. :: 流利来自每日练习。
column3: Fluency came from twenty minutes a day for a year, not from the weekend she spent cramming before the interview. :: 流利来自一年里每天二十分钟，而不是面试前那个周末的突击。

column2: The pronunciation uses US phonetics. :: 发音用美式音标。
column3: Pronunciation is the part everyone skips and the part that decides whether a sentence is understood. :: 发音是所有人都会跳过、却决定一句话能不能被听懂的部分。

column2: The phonetic hint appears after a miss. :: 答错后才显示音标。
column3: The phonetic spelling told us the word had three syllables, which was the whole reason we kept mis-typing it. :: 音标显示这个词有三个音节，这正是我们一直打错的全部原因。

column2: A mnemonic links the word to its meaning. :: 助记法把单词和含义联系起来。
column3: The mnemonic was ridiculous, which is exactly why it worked two months later when the meaning had faded. :: 这个助记法很荒唐，正因如此，两个月后含义模糊时它还有效。

column2: Etymology makes words stick. :: 词源让单词记得更牢。
column3: The etymology connected the word to one we already knew, and the two have been impossible to confuse since. :: 词源把这个词和我们已知的一个词连起来，从那以后两者再也不会混淆。

column2: A near synonym is enough context. :: 近义词就是足够的语境。
column3: The synonym was not exact, but seeing it next to the word told us which sense of it the example meant. :: 这个近义词并不精确，但把它放在单词旁边就说明了例句用的是哪个义项。

column2: The definition fits on one line. :: 定义一行就够。
column3: A definition that needs a paragraph is usually three definitions wearing one coat. :: 需要一整段才说得清的定义，通常是三个定义穿了一件外套。

column2: An example is worth ten rules. :: 一个例子胜过十条规则。
column3: The example showed the tricky part immediately, which the four rules above it had carefully avoided mentioning. :: 例子立刻展示了难点，而上面那四条规则小心地避开了它。

column2: Words stick better in context. :: 单词在语境里记得更牢。
column3: Context is what tells you whether "cache" here means the store, the act of hiding, or a person's secret stash. :: 语境才能告诉你这里的 cache 指的是缓存、藏起来这个动作，还是某人的私藏。

column2: The progress bar fills as you answer. :: 作答时进度条会填满。
column3: Progress was invisible for the first week, which is exactly when most people stop. :: 第一周进度完全看不见，而那正是大多数人放弃的时候。

column2: A ten-day streak builds a habit. :: 连续十天能养成习惯。
column3: The streak broke on a Tuesday and the tool went back to zero, which felt harsher than the habit deserved. :: 连续记录在一个周二断掉，工具直接归零，这比这个习惯应得的惩罚更严厉。

column2: Mark the hard words as favorites. :: 把难词标记为收藏。
column3: Favorites grew to two hundred words, at which point the list had become a second wordbook nobody curated. :: 收藏夹涨到两百个词，那时它已经变成一本没人整理的第二个词书。

column2: Master the word before you move on. :: 掌握之后才继续。
column3: Marking a word as mastered is an act of faith, and the tool should occasionally check whether you were right. :: 把词标记为已掌握是一种信念行为，工具偶尔该验证你是否判断正确。

column2: Review the missed words tomorrow. :: 明天复习错词。
column3: Review is where learning actually happens; the first pass is only the introduction. :: 记忆发生在复习环节，第一次只是介绍。

column2: A quick quiz fits between tasks. :: 小测验适合放在任务间隙。
column3: The quiz took ninety seconds and told us more about our progress than a week of reading had. :: 这个小测验花了九十秒，却比读一周书更能说明我们的进度。

column2: The drill takes ninety seconds. :: 训练只要九十秒。
column3: The drill is short on purpose: a long session is the one you skip tomorrow. :: 训练刻意做得短：时间长的那个，明天你就会跳过它。

column2: Ask for a hint before you give up. :: 放弃前先要个提示。
column3: The hint revealed one letter and the whole word came back, which is the difference between forgetting and never having learned it. :: 提示只露一个字母，整个词就想起来了，这就是「忘了」和「从没记住」的区别。

column2: Type the answer, then press Enter. :: 输入答案再回车。
column3: The answer was one letter off, and the tool recorded it as a complete failure, which is technically correct and practically discouraging. :: 答案差一个字母，工具记为彻底失败，技术上正确，实际上很打击人。

column2: The score resets every day. :: 得分每天重置。
column3: The score reset every day so that a bad Tuesday could not ruin the rest of the month. :: 得分每天重置，这样一个糟糕的周二不会毁掉整月。

column2: Accuracy matters more than speed. :: 准确率比速度重要。
column3: Accuracy and speed traded places as we typed more: the fast typist made four times as many spelling mistakes. :: 打得多以后准确率和速度此消彼长：打字快的人拼写错误多了四倍。

column2: A single typo fails the build. :: 一个错字让构建失败。
column3: The typo was in a string that only appeared in a log message, and it still managed to break a nightly job. :: 这个错字在一段只出现在日志里的字符串中，仍然弄坏了夜间任务。

column2: Turn off autocorrect while you type the word. :: 输入单词时关掉自动纠正。
column3: Autocorrect fixed the spelling and silently changed the word we were trying to learn. :: 自动纠正修好了拼写，也悄悄换掉了我们想学的那个词。

column2: Typing builds muscle memory. :: 打字建立肌肉记忆。
column3: Muscle memory is why you can type a password you have not thought about in a year and still get it wrong once. :: 肌肉记忆解释了你为什么能打出一个一年没想过的密码，然后还是打错一次。

column2: Memory fades without review. :: 不复习记忆会消退。
column3: Memory for the meaning fades fast, while memory for the shape of the word hangs around much longer. :: 对含义的记忆消退很快，对词形的记忆却停留得久得多。

column2: A small habit beats a big plan. :: 小习惯胜过宏大计划。
column3: The habit was ninety seconds after lunch, and it survived the week when the big plan did not. :: 这个习惯是午饭后九十秒，它熬过了大计划没熬过的那一周。

column2: Progress bars feed motivation. :: 进度条提供动机。
column3: Motivation is unreliable, which is why the tool counts sessions rather than waiting for you to feel ready. :: 动机不可靠，所以工具统计的是场次，而不是等你感觉准备好。

column2: Focus on one card at a time. :: 一次专注一张卡。
column3: Focus was easier once the interface stopped showing how many cards were left. :: 界面不再显示还剩多少张之后，专注变得容易了。

column2: Take a two-minute break between tasks. :: 任务间休息两分钟。
column3: The break was supposed to be two minutes and turned into twenty, which is the real reason the afternoon disappeared. :: 本来该休息两分钟，结果变成二十分钟，这才是下午消失的真正原因。

column2: The session recovers after a crash. :: 崩溃后会话恢复。
column3: The service recovered in seconds, but the data written in the last minute was gone and nobody had written that down anywhere. :: 服务几秒就恢复了，但最后一分钟写入的数据没了，而这一点没人写在任何地方。

column2: The state is saved on exit. :: 退出时保存状态。
column3: State that lives in the UI is state you will eventually duplicate in three other places. :: 存在于界面里的状态，最终会在其他三个地方被复制一次。

column2: The progress lives in local storage. :: 进度存在本地存储。
column3: Storage was local only, which meant that switching machines reset a year of progress and surprised exactly one person. :: 存储只在本地，这意味着换机器会重置一年的进度，正好让一个人很意外。

column2: Open settings to change the daily goal. :: 打开设置改每日目标。
column3: The settings page had forty options and the team used four of them, which is a ratio worth noticing. :: 设置页有四十个选项，团队用了四个，这个比例值得注意。

column2: One option is enough here. :: 这里一个选项就够。
column3: Every option you add is a branch someone has to test, and most of them will never be chosen. :: 每加一个选项都是一个必须有人测的分支，而大多数永远没人选。

column2: Toggle the mode with Tab. :: 用 Tab 切换模式。
column3: The toggle looked like a small convenience until we realised it changed what the Enter key did. :: 这个开关看起来只是个小便利，直到我们发现它改变了回车键的作用。

column2: The plugin registers two actions. :: 插件注册两个动作。
column3: A plugin that fails silently is worse than one that crashes, because you keep believing it is working. :: 静默失败的插件比崩溃的更糟，因为你会一直以为它在工作。

column2: The extension adds a pane entrypoint. :: 扩展增加一个窗格入口。
column3: Extensions are cheap to add and expensive to remove, because by then someone's workflow depends on them. :: 加扩展很便宜，删扩展很贵，因为到那时已经有人依赖它了。

column2: Each entrypoint maps to one command. :: 每个入口对应一条命令。
column3: The entrypoint was documented in a comment that the refactor moved three lines away from the code it described. :: 入口写在一段注释里，而重构把那行注释挪到了离代码三行远的地方。

column2: Register the handler at startup. :: 启动时注册处理函数。
column3: The handler was registered twice, so every event ran twice and every side effect happened in duplicate. :: 处理函数注册了两次，于是每个事件跑两遍，每个副作用都重复发生。

column2: The event fires when the agent goes idle. :: agent 空闲时触发事件。
column3: The event fired for every pane in the workspace, which meant one busy pane could delay the notification for all the others. :: 这个事件对工作区里每个窗格都会触发，于是一个繁忙的窗格能拖慢所有其他窗格的通知。

column2: The event triggers a gentle nudge. :: 事件触发一次温和提醒。
column3: The trigger was correct; the problem was that it fired at three in the morning and nobody had thought about quiet hours. :: 触发逻辑没错，问题是它在凌晨三点触发，而没人考虑过静默时段。

column2: A gentle nudge keeps the habit alive. :: 温和提醒让习惯延续。
column3: A nudge that arrives every hour is not a nudge, it is a reason to uninstall. :: 每小时来一次的提醒不叫提醒，那叫让人卸载的理由。

column2: The reminder fires after 45 minutes. :: 提醒在 45 分钟后触发。
column3: The reminder was helpful for a week and then became the thing everyone reflexively dismissed. :: 提醒有用了一周，之后就成了所有人条件反射关掉的东西。

column2: Silence the reminder for tonight. :: 今晚把提醒静音。
column3: Silence is a feature: a tool that cannot be quiet gets turned off entirely. :: 静音是一种功能：一个无法安静的工具会被彻底关掉。

column2: Press Ctrl+R to hear it pronounced. :: 按 Ctrl+R 听发音。
column3: Pronouncing the word out loud was the step that finally made the spelling stick. :: 大声把词念出来，正是让拼写终于记住的那一步。

column2: The speaker reads the word aloud. :: 扬声器朗读单词。
column3: The speaker read the word in an accent the user had never heard, which was still better than nothing. :: 扬声器用用户从没听过的口音读了这个词，仍然比没有好。

column2: Turn the volume down at night. :: 夜间把音量调低。
column3: The volume was fine until the tool announced a finished session in a silent office at nine in the evening. :: 音量本来没问题，直到它在晚上九点安静的办公室里宣布一组训练完成。

column2: Audio is optional in this drill. :: 音频在这里是可选的。
column3: Audio helps recognition and hides the fact that you cannot spell the word, which is why typing matters more. :: 音频有助于辨认，也会掩盖你不会拼写这件事，所以打字更重要。

column2: The drill runs inside the terminal. :: 训练在终端里运行。
column3: The terminal is where you already are, which is the whole reason this tool exists inside one. :: 你本来就在终端里，这正是这个工具要住在终端里的全部理由。

column2: The prompt shows the Chinese meaning. :: 提示显示中文含义。
column3: A prompt that gives away too much turns recall into reading, and reading is what you already know how to do. :: 提示给得太多，就把回忆变成了阅读，而阅读你本来就会。

column2: The cursor blinks in the input box. :: 光标在输入框里闪。
column3: The cursor was the only thing moving on the screen, which made a hundred milliseconds feel like a second. :: 屏幕上唯一在动的是光标，这让一百毫秒感觉像一秒。

column2: The input accepts the whole word. :: 输入框接受整词。
column3: The input accepted everything and validated nothing, so the failure surfaced two screens later in a different service. :: 输入什么都接受、什么都不校验，于是失败在两个界面之后、另一个服务里才暴露。

column2: The output is one line per word. :: 输出每词一行。
column3: The output was designed to be read by a human and was immediately parsed by four scripts, all of which broke when we changed a space. :: 输出本来是给人读的，立刻被四个脚本拿去解析，我们改一个空格它们全挂了。

column2: The panel shows the daily stats. :: 面板显示当日统计。
column3: The panel refreshed every second, which cost more than the feature it was displaying. :: 面板每秒刷新，成本超过了它展示的那个功能本身。

column2: The status line shows the streak. :: 状态栏显示连续天数。
column3: The status line was the only place the elapsed time appeared, and it was the first thing to be cut on a narrow window. :: 状态栏是唯一显示用时的地方，也是窄窗口里第一个被砍掉的东西。

column2: The card has a soft border. :: 卡片有柔和边框。
column3: The border was one cell wide and made the whole layout readable at a glance, which is more than most features manage. :: 边框只有一格宽，却让整个布局一眼可读，比大多数功能做得都多。

column2: The dark theme fits the terminal. :: 深色主题适合终端。
column3: The theme respected the terminal's own colours, so the tool looked native in every setup we tried. :: 主题尊重终端自己的配色，于是它在我们试过的每种环境里都像是原生的。

column2: The contrast is high enough to read. :: 对比度够高，看得清。
column3: Contrast that looks fine on your monitor at noon is unreadable on a laptop at night, which is when people actually study. :: 中午在你显示器上看着够的对比度，在夜里的笔记本上根本看不清，而那才是人们真正学习的时间。

column2: Highlight the matching letters in green. :: 用绿色高亮匹配字母。
column3: Highlighting the wrong letters told us exactly where the typo was before the verdict appeared, which is the whole point. :: 高亮出错的字母，在判分出现之前就告诉我们错在哪，这正是重点。

column2: The palette has six muted colours. :: 调色板有六种柔和颜色。
column3: The palette was chosen to survive a light terminal and a dark one, which is why it looks slightly muted in both. :: 这套配色是为在浅色和深色终端里都能看清而挑的，所以在两者里都显得稍微偏灰。
